methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper is aimed to present some instruments and tools for assisting the status evaluation of energy consumption, improving instruments for data monitoring and helping the implementation and maintenance of EnMS in a company.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents an EnMS implementation and conformity-assessment framework without identifying or characterising an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The evaluation aimed according the fulfilment degree of ISO 50001 standard requirements performed at Knorr Bremse

stage1.notes: ISO 50001 planning concepts, baseline and EnPI labels are mentioned, but no measurement model, functional form, variables, or estimation method is characterised.
